exposure: Prenatal exposure to maternal serum concentrations of nine Polyfluoroalkyl Substances (PFASs)
cohort: The study included 1008 mother-infant pairs from the Guangxi Zhuang Birth Cohort in China.
finding: The study found that prenatal exposure to certain PFASs (PFOS, PFHxS, and PFBS) was associated with enhanced visual acuity and reduced odds of visual impairment in preschool children, which does not support the hypothesis of an adverse impact on visual development.
